_comment: FROZEN blind-authored routing holdout. Lane A (contracts / ZK), Lane B (assets / standards / dapp / data), and Lane C (LumenLoop / payments KEEP-LIST only) were authored deliberately by three different model families without scorer internals, current rankings, or eval results. Cross-chain, CCTP, Axelar, bridging, ITS, and NEAR Intents are excluded by design. This instrument is measured, never optimized toward: do not iterate its queries, labels, or forbidden captures while tuning a scorer.
author: Lane A, Lane B, and Lane C blind authors (three different model families)

cases.question: how do I make a soroban contract upgradeable with openzeppelin

We shipped a fungible token built on the OpenZeppelin Stellar crates and v2 changes the shape of one persistent storage entry — is there a way to swap the wasm and run the migration in a single atomic call, and where exactly is the authorization check supposed to live?
add openzeppelin stellar crates to my Cargo.toml

Starting a fresh Soroban workspace and I want to build on OpenZeppelin's Stellar contracts — which of their crates do I actually need, do they belong in the root workspace Cargo.toml or the per-contract one, and why do the imports use underscores when the crate names have dashes?
verify a groth16 proof inside a soroban contract

I have a Circom circuit compiled with snarkjs and I want the proof checked on-chain rather than by our backend — what does the verifier contract look like on Stellar, which curve should I compile the circuit for, and how do I get the decimal-string points out of proof.json into whatever types the contract expects?
audit checklist before mainnet for my soroban contract

Before we go to mainnet I want to review our escrow contract for the usual Soroban footguns — a middleware path that forgets require_auth, reinitialization, loops bounded by user-controlled input — is there a checklist for this and which static analyzers are worth running in CI?
add pausable and ownable to my existing token contract
